name: Firebird AI Factory DC-1 Hrazdan
notes: Opened 2026-08-08 as CIS region's largest AI factory near Hrazdan, Kotayk marz; phase one worth >USD 500M of ~USD 5B total; operator page: DC-1 powered by 6,144 NVIDIA B200 GPUs across 15 MW; roadmap to >70,000 GPUs / 300 MW by end-2027 is announced, not commissioned.

name: OVIO / GNC-ALFA Data Center Abovyan
notes: Commercial colo/cloud in Abovyan, Kotayk, operational since May 2024; operator states 2 MW / 216 server cabinets; two independent 35 kV substations; Uptime Tier III Certification of Design Documents only (not constructed-facility certification).

name: Eleveight AI Factory Gagarin
notes: First AI factory in Gagarin, Gegharkunik (Gortsaranayin St 1); 512 NVIDIA B300 GPUs deployed and in commercial service; current electrical capacity ~1.2-2 MW (press varies), phased to 5 MW then 35 MW; scaling target 40 MW per methodology; first-phase investment reported USD 70M (arkatelecom) vs USD 120M (ministry) - reconcile.

name: VSData Green Data Center
notes: Tier-3-spec green DC in a gorge in Aragatsotn (North-South Hwy), 2 MW / 125 racks, spring-water cooling, 25 km fiber to Yerevan; operator site claims under construction with third power line in progress; baxtel says ground broken with end-2025 target; no official commissioning/operational evidence found - keep construction/planned.

name: Viva Data Centers
notes: Commercial colo at advanced data centers in Yerevan (directory names Kochar and Karekin Njdeh sites); Tier III standard design, 2N power/cooling, dual high-voltage feeds, diesel generators, UPS; capacity not published.

name: TeamCloud / Team Telecom Armenia Data Center
notes: Colocation and cloud servers hosted in Team Telecom Armenia data center; Tier III international-standards claim per operator page; exact facility address requires separate corroboration (A for service claim, B/C for address).

name: Yerevan State University AI Data Center / Supercomputer
notes: Institutional/research AI supercomputing center at YSU opened January 2026; 64 NVIDIA H100 GPUs, government funding ~AMD 3.4B (~USD 9M); institutional HPC, not commercial colo.

name: Armenian National Supercomputing Center (ANSCC)
developer: Government of Armenia / NAS RA / EIF (public-private)
notes: Inaugurated 2024-05-31 at Engineering City, Yerevan; first supercomputer in the region, donated by Toulouse Institute of Computer Science Research; institutional HPC, not commercial colo; new find this run.

name: Datacom / ADC Core Network data center
notes: Historical directory/trade lead for a Yerevan facility; C-grade until current operator page, permit, or procurement evidence appears; not independently re-verified this run (directory page rate-limited).
